question.text: Which investment channels are described in the source as particularly suited to HNIs and other sophisticated investors seeking customised strategies?

answer.text: Portfolio Management Services (PMS) and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.27 describes PMS as suited to HNIs seeking customised strategies, and source p.83 (with category details on pp.89-90) describes AIFs as targeting HNIs and other sophisticated investors. Direct investments are listed as a separate channel on p.25. The Trap: Savings accounts, plain retail mutual funds, or a single stock are not the HNI-focused customised-strategy channels highlighted by the source. Note: Choice between PMS and AIF categories depends on the investor's specific objectives and constraints discussed in the same chapters.
